name: Mikimoto Haruna
source: She is friendly, humble, and kind to everyone around her, making her approachable and well-liked by both men and women. Unlike her mother, she is well-liked in the school, and even though the main character is isolated, she is one of his classmates and treats him as casually as any other student. She has a charming personality, sometimes showing a ditzy side.
